# Fixtures

Synthetic data in the shape the brief describes. The pipeline is built and tested against these until the real dataset lands. No real patient data.

Generated by `python tools/make_fixtures.py` from a fixed seed. `tests/test_fixtures.py` checks that a fresh run reproduces these files byte for byte.

| File | Rows | What it is |
|---|---|---|
| `patients.csv` | 200 | Age, weight, eGFR, pregnancy, diagnoses, and the medication list as written on the slip (`\|`-separated) |
| `drugs.csv` | 68 | Generic, class, Indian brand names, renal-adjustment flag, pregnancy level |
| `interactions.csv` | 195 | Generic pairs with table severity and mechanism, expanded from the 89 Round 1 rules |
| `ground_truth.csv` | 1,503 | The true generic behind every medication string, and how it was mangled. The adapter never reads it; Phase 2 measures resolution against it |

The drug and interaction tables are the Round 1 reference (`ui/src/data/drugs.ts`): clinically genuine, commonly cited interactions, reduced to 68 generics. Some clinical cells are deliberately blank, because real records have gaps. A blank loads as `None`, never `0`.
